beats.text: My boss asked me to work Saturday for the third weekend in a row, so I finally said no.

On Monday, nobody would talk to me. My chair was moved to the storage room, and my name was missing from the team lunch order. Then I found out my boss told everyone I was putting the whole project at risk.

So I printed every late night email and every weekend text, and I brought them to the big meeting. I laid them on the table and said, if hard work matters here, the records speak for themselves. The room went silent, and my boss never asked me to work a weekend again. Comment if you would have done the same, and follow for the next story.

card_text: I said no, then they moved my desk
